title: AoPS Wiki:Advertisement
text:
Advertising often involves promoting products or services that are either related or completely unrelated to the content of the page.

If you come across any AoPS Wiki pages containing advertisements, please click "Edit" and add the following {{delete|advertising}}

Many recent pages on the AoPS Wiki have been created with the intention of advertising, sometimes unrelated to AoPS, and often in other languages. Please help us propose these pages for deletion. Exercise caution when proposing a page in a foreign language for deletion.
